New users start as OPERATOR with no scope. tenantCode is optional (defaults to your own tenant). Password 8 to 72 characters (BE-36); the new user must change it at their first sign-in (mustChangePassword: true). HQ creates a new store's Owner: register with the store's tenantCode, then user-update-scope OWNER.

Returns a token, plus mustChangePassword (BE-36): true when someone else chose this password (a new account or a reset), so the app opens Change password first. A switched-off account gets 403 (BE-33).

An ADMIN inside their tree, only up to their own stored scope, never their own, never someone above them (BE-31); or (BE-34) a store's Owner, for their own store's people below Owner, giving SUPERVISOR or MANAGER only. All refusals 403. Locally, grant Owner as the HQ super admin.
An ADMIN inside their tree, never their own (BE-07); or (BE-34) a store's Owner, for their own store's people below Owner, any role except ADMIN (403).

BE-32. Any signed-in user changes their own password (no user id: always yours). newPassword 8 to 72 characters and different from the current one. A wrong currentPassword is 400 (not 401, so the app keeps the session). Returns a fresh token; put it in bearerToken. Tokens issued before the change keep working until they expire (24 hours).

BE-33. An ADMIN inside their tree, never someone above them; or (BE-34) a store's Owner, for their own store's people below Owner (not Owners, not Admins). Never yourself (403). A reason is required to switch off (400). A switched-off user can't log in (403), their token stops at once (401), they no longer count as one of the store's Owners, get no new notifications, and can't be named on a new record.

Then PUT the file to putUrl with the returned Content-Type header, no Authorization, at most sizeBytes of body. purpose: GOODS_RECEIPT_PHOTO | EXPENSE_RECEIPT | PURCHASE_RECEIPT. Types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf. Max 5 MB. With UPLOAD_STORAGE=local (default) putUrl points back at this server (/uploads-local) and the file is saved under local-uploads/; with UPLOAD_STORAGE=r2 it points at Cloudflare R2 (503 if R2 isn't configured).
